ideas.pitch: An AI-powered institutional event concierge and real-time navigation app designed specifically for IEEE conferences and ideathons to handle schedules, venue spots, and team announcements.
ideas.title: IEEE Campus Navigational and Event Co-Pilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to organisers and judges in the room during IEEE Days 2026, featuring a live functional demo that directly streamlines the event logistics.

ideas.pitch: A tracking and rewards web app that incentivizes carbon footprint reduction and recycling initiatives across college campuses.
ideas.title: CampusGreen Impact Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides clear, measurable social and environmental impact metrics which judges look for in real-world feasibility evaluations.

ideas.pitch: A localized multilingual AI health awareness and preventive care chatbot tailored for semi-urban and rural outreach initiatives.
ideas.title: RuralMed Health Awareness Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles high-impact social welfare problems with a proven architectural pattern from previous winning entries.

ideas.pitch: A quick-capture knowledge management platform that documents internal team project artifacts and automatically answers newcomer onboarding questions before project handovers.
ideas.title: EngiKnowledge Lifecycle Handover Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem developers and technical judges experience firsthand, featuring genuinely hard engineering applied to document retrieval.

ideas.pitch: An analytical risk forecasting dashboard that utilizes historical incident indicators to provide calibrated safety prediction intervals and alerts for university campuses.
ideas.title: Campus Incident and Safety Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced data-driven forecasting feasibility and structured reporting that impresses judging panels looking for rigorous implementation.
